issue.title: [v1.2.0] Retry embed batch on partial response
issue.description:
**Bug**: the embedding batch call sometimes returns fewer vectors than items submitted, and the partial result passes through instead of triggering a retry.

**Fix**:

1. Detect when the response length is smaller than the batch length and raise a retryable error the retry decorator catches.
2. Add a test with a mocked partial response -- assert the retry happens and the final result succeeds.

Effort: half-day.

nodes.body: Landed in commit abc123 -- retry now triggers on partial batch responses.
